info.title: Aster API
info.description: The Aster API the Android app calls. The contract is §5 of docs/aster-backend-plan.md. Send `Accept: application/json` and `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: a device token from /auth/register or /auth/login, or a profile token from /profiles/{id}/unlock.

post.summary:
Stores new events and skips ones already stored. The household comes
from the device token, never from the request

get.summary:
The profile's own events, newest first. The Owner also sees device
events, which belong to no profile

post.summary:
Upserts 1–50 messages by client_uuid in one transaction, so a retried
upload stores nothing twice and returns the same ids
Idempotent by client_uuid: 201 when new, 200 when the phone retries

Stores new points, skips ones already stored, and discards everything
while tracking is off or paused

get.summary: One local day, in the requested IANA timezone, oldest point first

put.summary: Creates or replaces the home. Always 200, as §5 says, even on the first save

post.summary: Idempotent by client_uuid: 201 when new, 200 when the phone retries

examples: You can only lock your own profile.

type.description: A plain string rather than ActivityType, so a newer app can send new types.

ReminderRequest.description:
POST needs client_uuid, title and trigger; PATCH and PUT change only what
they send. The controller checks that a time reminder ends up with a due_at.
